meta.name: i18n-localization
meta.description: Set up and operate the localization pipeline for any product: source-string extraction, translation memory, locale matrix selection, RTL/CJK support, plural rules, ICU MessageFormat, cultural adaptation, voice-over recording where relevant, locale-specific QA, and store-listing translation. Produces locale plan, string-table source-of-truth, translator brief, glossary, locale-specific test plan, and release-gate verdict on missing or low-quality translations. Use whenever the product ships in more than one language, before any visible string is hardcoded, and as a recurring gate before release.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建多语言产品发布前的翻译质量把关流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品需要支持多种语言,且怕发布后出现翻译缺漏。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a translation quality gate for multilingual product releases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product ships in multiple languages and you want to avoid release-time translation gaps.

howto.what: 把它接入后,Claude会为你的产品搭建多语言发布流程:提取所有可见文案、生成翻译简报和词汇表,检查复数、RTL/CJK、日期货币等格式,并按区域做质量检查,最后给出每个语言能否发布的裁决。
howto.when: 当产品要支持不止一种语言时,且在任何可见文案写死之前,或每次发布前需要检查本地化质量时触发。

say.text: 我的App要中英双语,帮我搭本地化流程
say.note: 它会先读流程文档并制定区域矩阵。

say.text: 把这份界面文案提取成字符串表,并检查有无硬编码。
say.note: 它会生成平台格式的字符串表。

say.text: 发布前按计划做一次本地化门禁检查。

howto.what_en: Once added, Claude sets up a multilingual release pipeline for your product: extracts visible strings, produces translator brief and glossary, checks plurals, RTL/CJK, date/currency formats, runs per-locale QA, and issues a release verdict per language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the product ships in more than one language, before any visible string is hardcoded, and as a recurring gate before release.

say_en.text: Set up a localization pipeline for my bilingual app (EN/ZH).
say_en.note: It builds the locale matrix and fallback chain.

say_en.text: Extract UI strings and flag any hardcoded ones.
say_en.note: It creates string tables per platform.

say_en.text: Run the pre-release i18n gate check.
say_en.note: It gives a Go/Conditional/Hold verdict per locale.
